chapters.name: Babi na 1: Ra'ayoyin cloud da ginshiƙan Azure

lessons.title: Darasi 1: Mene ne cloud, kuma me yasa ƙungiyoyi ke amfani da shi
lessons.text:
Darasi 1 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Bayyana cloud computing da manyan amfaninsa da misali na yau da kullum.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku misali na yau da kullum kamar shafin intanet na bankin abinci mai cunkoso, za ku iya bayyana mene ne cloud computing da ambaton manyan amfaninsa da nau'o'in cloud, da kalmominku, tare da aƙalla amfani biyu daidai.
Cloud computing (lissafin girgije) yana nufin hayar ƙarfin kwamfuta, ma'ajiya da manhajoji ta intanet, maimakon sayen sabobinku (servers) da tafiyar da su da kanku. Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services da Google Cloud su ne manyan masu bayar da cloud.
Yana kama da wutar lantarki: ba ku gina tashar wuta, kuna jona ne kawai ku biya abin da kuka yi amfani da shi. Ana kiran wannan tsarin biyan-abin-da-aka-yi-amfani-da-shi (consumption-based ko pay-as-you-go). Maimakon babban saye a farko (kuɗin jari, CapEx), kuna biyan kuɗin tafiyarwa (kuɗin gudanarwa, OpEx).
Manyan amfani: faɗaɗawa (scalability: ƙara ƙarfi idan shafin rajista na bankin abinci ya cika da mutane, sannan a rage shi), samuwa koyaushe (high availability: yana ci gaba da aiki ko da na'ura ɗaya ta lalace), dogaro, kayan tsaro, da sauƙin gudanarwa. Akwai nau'o'in cloud uku: na jama'a (public: mai bayarwa da ake rabawa kamar Azure), na sirri (private: ƙungiya ɗaya kaɗai ke amfani da shi) da gauraye (hybrid: haɗin biyun).
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Cloud computing: hayar ƙarfin kwamfuta, ma'ajiya da manhajoji ta intanet.
- Tsarin biyan-abin-da-aka-yi-amfani-da-shi (consumption-based): kuna biyan abin da kuka yi amfani da shi kaɗai.
- CapEx / OpEx: kuɗin jari babban saye ne a farko; kuɗin gudanarwa kuɗi ne da ake ci gaba da biya.
- Faɗaɗawa (scalability): ƙara ko rage albarkatu yayin da buƙata ta canja.
- Samuwa koyaushe (high availability): hidima tana ci gaba da aiki ko da wasu sassanta sun lalace.
- Cloud gauraye (hybrid cloud): haɗin cloud na jama'a da tsarin sirri na ƙungiya.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft Learn: Jagorar karatu don jarabawar AZ-900
Gwada yanzu: Ku zaɓi wata ƙungiya a yankinku da kuka sani (coci, masallaci, asibiti, makaranta, bankin abinci ko ƙaramin shago). Ku rubuta hanyoyi biyu da za ta iya amfani da cloud, da wane amfani (faɗaɗawa, samuwa, biyan-abin-da-aka-yi-amfani-da-shi) kowanne ke ba ta.
Yanzu za ku iya bayyana cloud computing, tsarin biyan-abin-da-aka-yi-amfani-da-shi, amfaninsa da nau'o'in cloud uku.

check.q: Mene ne OpEx a cloud computing?
options: Babban saye na sabobi a farko
Kuɗin tafiyarwa da kuke biya yayin da kuke amfani da hidimar
Wani nau'in virtual machine
Gwaji kyauta da ba ya ƙarewa
check.why: Biyan-abin-da-aka-yi-amfani-da-shi yana mayar da babban saye a farko (CapEx) zuwa kuɗin gudanarwa da ake ci gaba da biya (OpEx).

check.q: Wani asibiti dole ya ajiye wasu bayanai a sabobinsa, amma yana son Azure don shafinsa na intanet. Wane nau'in cloud ya dace?
options: Na jama'a kaɗai
Na sirri kaɗai
Babu cloud kwata-kwata
Gauraye (hybrid)
check.why: Cloud gauraye yana haɗa sabobin ƙungiya da cloud na jama'a kamar Azure.

lessons.title: Darasi 2: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS da wanda ke da alhakin kowane abu
lessons.text:
Darasi 2 cikin 6 · kusan minti 5
Manufa: Rarraba hidima cikin IaaS, PaaS ko SaaS da faɗin wanda ke kula da me.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku wata hidimar cloud, za ku iya rarraba ta cikin IaaS, PaaS ko SaaS da faɗin abin da mai bayarwa da abokin ciniki kowannensu ke karewa, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Hidimomin cloud iri uku ne. IaaS (infrastructure as a service, ginshiƙi a matsayin hidima): kuna hayar virtual machines (kwamfutoci na manhaja) da hanyoyin sadarwa, kuma ku ne ke kula da kusan komai a kansu, kamar hayar gida babu kayan ɗaki. PaaS (platform as a service, dandali a matsayin hidima): mai bayarwa ne ke tafiyar da sabobi da manhajojin tsari; ku kuna kawo manhajarku ko bayananku, kamar gida da kayan ɗaki. SaaS (software as a service, manhaja a matsayin hidima): kuna amfani da manhajar da aka gama kawai, kamar imel na Outlook ko Microsoft Teams, kamar ɗakin otal.
Serverless (ba-sabar) wani nau'in PaaS ne inda lambar kwamfutarku (code) take aiki ne kawai idan wani abu ya tayar da ita, kuma kuna biya gwargwadon amfani, babu sabar da za ku kula da ita kwata-kwata (Azure Functions misali ne).
Tsarin raba alhaki (shared responsibility model) yana faɗin wanda ke kare me. Mai bayarwa koyaushe yana tsare gine-ginen cibiyoyin bayanai (datacenters). Ku koyaushe kuna da alhakin bayananku, asusunku da wanda ke da damar shiga. A tsakani, yayin da kuke tafiya daga IaaS zuwa SaaS, mai bayarwa yana ƙara ɗaukar aiki.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku tambaya: shin mu ne muke kula da tsarin aiki (operating system)? Idan e, IaaS ne.
- Shin manhajarmu ko bayananmu kawai muke kawowa? To PaaS ne.
- Shin muna shiga ne kawai mu yi amfani da manhajar? To SaaS ne.
- Ku tuna: bayananku da asusunku koyaushe aikinku ne.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- IaaS: ginshiƙi a matsayin hidima: kuna hayar virtual machines kuma ku kula da su.
- PaaS: dandali a matsayin hidima: mai bayarwa yana tafiyar da dandalin; ku kuna kawo manhajarku.
- SaaS: manhaja a matsayin hidima: manhajar da aka shirya don amfani ta intanet.
- Serverless (ba-sabar): code da ke aiki ne kawai idan an tayar da shi, babu sabar da za ku kula da ita.
- Tsarin raba alhaki: yadda ake raba ayyukan tsaro tsakanin mai bayar da cloud da ku.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft Learn: Jagorar karatu don jarabawar AZ-900
Gwada yanzu: Ku rarraba waɗannan cikin IaaS, PaaS ko SaaS: imel na Microsoft Outlook, Azure virtual machine, Azure App Service don shafin intanet, Microsoft Teams, Azure Functions. Sannan ku rubuta abu ɗaya da koyaushe ku ke da alhakinsa, ko wane iri ne.
Yanzu za ku iya bambance IaaS, PaaS da SaaS da bayyana tsarin raba alhaki.

check.q: Wane nau'i ne yake kama da hayar gida da kayan ɗaki: mai bayarwa yana tafiyar da sabobi, ku kuma kuna kawo manhajarku?
options: PaaS
IaaS
SaaS
Cloud na sirri
check.why: A PaaS mai bayarwa yana tafiyar da sabobi da manhajojin tsari; ku kuna kawo manhajarku ko bayananku.

check.q: Ƙungiyarku mai zaman kanta (nonprofit) ta koma daga IaaS zuwa SaaS. Me zai faru da aikin tsaronta?
options: Yanzu dole ta tsare cibiyar bayanai
Babu abin da zai canja kwata-kwata
Mai bayarwa zai ƙara ɗaukar aiki, amma bayananku da asusunku har yanzu aikinku ne
Mai bayarwa zai zama mai alhakin kalmomin sirrinku
check.why: Komawa zuwa SaaS yana mayar da ƙarin aiki ga mai bayarwa, amma bayananku da damar shiga koyaushe naku ne.

lessons.title: Darasi 3: Yadda aka tsara Azure: yankuna, zones da resource groups
lessons.text:
Darasi 3 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Bayyana inda Azure ke aiki da yadda ake tsara albarkatu da nemo su a Azure portal.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don ƙaramin aikin Azure, za ku iya zaɓar yanki (region) da resource group da bayyana yadda suke shiga cikin subscription, tare da dalilin yankin da kuka zaɓa.
Azure yana aiki a cibiyoyin bayanai (datacenters) a faɗin duniya, waɗanda aka haɗa su cikin yankuna (regions), kamar East US ko South Africa North. Kuna zaɓar yanki don kowane abu da kuka gina: kusa da masu amfani yawanci ya fi sauri, kuma wasu bayanai suna da ƙa'idoji kan ƙasar da dole su zauna a ciki. Yankuna da yawa suna da availability zones (zones na samuwa): cibiyoyin bayanai daban-daban masu nasu wutar lantarki da sanyaya, don idan ɗaya ya lalace, wani ya ci gaba da aiki. Ana kuma haɗa yankuna biyu-biyu da wani yanki a yanki ɗaya na ƙasa don farfaɗowa daga bala'i.
Duk abin da kuka ƙirƙira (virtual machine, rumbun bayanai wato database, storage account) ana kiransa resource (albarka). Albarkatu suna shiga resource groups, wato manyan fayiloli (folders) na abubuwan da suke tare, kamar duk abin da ke na shafin intanet ɗaya. Resource groups suna cikin subscription, wato asusun biyan kuɗi. Manyan ƙungiyoyi suna haɗa subscriptions da management groups.
Kuna gudanar da duk wannan a Azure portal, shafin intanet a portal.azure.com. Kuna kuma iya amfani da Azure Cloud Shell, Azure CLI ko Azure PowerShell don gudanar da shi ta hanyar rubuta umarni.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku zaɓi yanki kusa da masu amfani da ya cika duk ƙa'idojin bayanai.
- Ku yi amfani da availability zones idan dole hidimar ta ci gaba da aiki.
- Ku sa albarkatun da suke tare a resource group ɗaya.
- Ku san wane subscription ne ke biyan kuɗinsu.
- Ku gudanar da komai a Azure portal ko da kayan aikin rubuta umarni.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Yanki (region): wani wuri a duniya mai cibiyar bayanai ɗaya ko fiye ta Azure.
- Availability zone: cibiyar bayanai daban a cikin yanki mai nata wutar lantarki, sanyaya da hanyar sadarwa.
- Resource (albarka): duk abin da kuka ƙirƙira a Azure, kamar virtual machine ko database.
- Resource group: babban fayil (folder) da ke ɗauke da albarkatun da suke tare.
- Subscription: asusun da ake ɗora kuɗin Azure a kansa.
- Management group: hanyar haɗa subscriptions da yawa ƙarƙashin ƙa'idoji ɗaya.
- Azure portal: shafin intanet don gudanar da Azure.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft Learn: Jagorar karatu don jarabawar AZ-900
Gwada yanzu: Ku tsara wa wata cibiyar al'umma da ke son shafin intanet da wurin ajiye fom ɗin rajista: ku sa wa resource group suna, ku jera albarkatu biyu da za su shiga ciki, ku zaɓi yanki kusa da ku. Ku rubuta dalili ɗaya na zaɓin yankinku.
Yanzu za ku iya bayyana yankuna, availability zones, albarkatu, resource groups, subscriptions da management groups.

check.q: Mene ne resource group a Azure?
options: Ƙungiyar ma'aikatan Microsoft
Wani nau'in virtual machine
Asusun biyan kuɗi
Babban fayil na albarkatun da suke tare, kamar shafin intanet ɗaya
check.why: Resource groups suna ɗauke da albarkatun da suke tare; subscription ne asusun biyan kuɗi.

check.q: Masu amfani da ku suna South Africa, kuma dole bayanansu su zauna a ƙasar. Ta yaya za ku zaɓi yanki?
options: Ku zaɓi yanki mafi arha a ko'ina
Ku zaɓi yanki kusa da masu amfani da ya cika ƙa'idojin bayanai
Ku zaɓi yanki ba tare da tunani ba
Ku yi amfani da kowane yanki a lokaci ɗaya
check.why: Ku zaɓi yanki kusa da masu amfani da kuma ya cika duk ƙa'idoji kan inda dole bayanai su zauna.

chapters.name: Babi na 2: Manyan hidimomi, kuɗi da takardar shaidarku

lessons.title: Darasi 4: Manyan hidimomin Azure: compute, networking, ma'ajiya da databases
lessons.text:
Darasi 4 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Daidaita buƙata ta yau da kullum da babbar hidimar Azure da ta dace.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Idan aka ba ku buƙata ta yau da kullum kamar shafin intanet, cikakkiyar sabar (server) ko ajiyar madadi (backup), za ku iya daidaita buƙatar da babbar hidimar Azure da ta dace, kuna samun aƙalla 4 cikin 5 daidai.
Compute (ƙarfin sarrafawa) yana tafiyar da shirye-shiryenku. Azure Virtual Machines suna ba ku cikakkiyar kwamfuta a cloud (IaaS). Azure App Service yana ɗaukar shafukan intanet da manhajojin yanar gizo ba tare da kun kula da sabobi ba (PaaS). Containers suna ɗaure manhaja tare da duk abin da take buƙata don ta yi aiki iri ɗaya a ko'ina. Azure Functions yana tafiyar da ƙananan sassan code idan an tayar da su (serverless). Azure Virtual Desktop yana ba mutane tebur na Windows da za su iya shiga daga kowace na'ura.
Networking (hanyoyin sadarwa) yana haɗa abubuwa. Azure virtual network ita ce hanyar sadarwarku ta sirri a cloud. VPN Gateway yana haɗa ta da ofishinku ta intanet; ExpressRoute haɗi ne na sirri da ba ya bi ta intanet na jama'a. Azure DNS yana mayar da sunaye zuwa adireshi.
Ma'ajiya (storage) tana ajiye fayiloli da bayanai. Storage account yana ɗauke da Blob storage (hotuna, bidiyo, madadi), Azure Files (manyan fayiloli da ake rabawa), queues da tables. Matakan ma'ajiya (hot, cool, cold, archive) suna ƙara arha yayin da ba ku cika buɗe fayilolin ba. Zaɓuɓɓukan redundancy suna ajiye ƙarin kwafi don lalacewa kada ta rasa bayanai. Don databases, Azure yana da zaɓuɓɓuka da ake kula da su kamar Azure SQL Database da Azure Cosmos DB.
Mataki-mataki:
- Kuna buƙatar shafin intanet? Ku duba Azure App Service.
- Kuna buƙatar cikakken iko kan sabar? Azure Virtual Machines.
- Kuna buƙatar code ya yi aiki idan wani abu ya faru? Azure Functions.
- Kuna buƙatar ajiye fayiloli ko madadi? Storage account da Blob storage.
- Fayilolin da ba a cika buɗewa ba? Ku yi amfani da mataki mafi sanyi kuma mafi arha.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Virtual machine (VM): kwamfuta da ke aiki a matsayin manhaja a cloud.
- Azure App Service: hidimar PaaS don ɗaukar shafukan intanet da manhajojin yanar gizo.
- Container: ɗauri na manhaja da duk abin da take buƙata don ta yi aiki.
- Virtual network: hanyar sadarwa ta sirri don albarkatunku na Azure.
- Blob storage: ma'ajiya don manyan fayiloli kamar hotuna, bidiyo da madadi.
- Matakin ma'ajiya (storage tier): matakin farashi bisa yadda kuke yawan buɗe bayanan: hot, cool, cold ko archive.
- Redundancy: ajiye ƙarin kwafi don bayanai su tsira idan an sami lalacewa.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft Learn: Jagorar karatu don jarabawar AZ-900
Gwada yanzu: Don cibiyar al'umma ta Darasi na 3, ku zaɓi hidima don kowace buƙata: shafin intanet na jama'a, wurin ajiye fom ɗin rajista da aka ɗauki hotonsu (scan), da tsofaffin hotuna da kusan ba a taɓa buɗewa ba. Ku rubuta wace hidima ce, kuma don hotunan, wane matakin ma'ajiya.
Yanzu za ku iya daidaita buƙatu na yau da kullum da hidimomin Azure na compute, networking, ma'ajiya da databases.

check.q: Wace hidimar Azure ce ke tafiyar da ƙananan sassan code ne kawai idan wani abu ya tayar da su?
options: Azure Virtual Machines
Azure DNS
Azure Functions
ExpressRoute
check.why: Azure Functions serverless ne: code yana aiki idan an tayar da shi, kuma kuna biya gwargwadon amfani.

check.q: Wata cibiyar matasa tana buƙatar babban fayil da ake rabawa wanda duk ma'aikatanta za su iya buɗewa. Me za ku ba da shawara?
options: Azure Files a cikin storage account
Azure Virtual Desktop
VPN Gateway
Azure SQL Database
check.why: Azure Files a cikin storage account yana ba da manyan fayiloli da ake rabawa.

lessons.title: Darasi 5: Tsaro, gudanarwa da sarrafa kuɗi
lessons.text:
Darasi 5 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Ambaci kayan aikin Azure da ke kiyaye asusu, tilasta ƙa'idoji da hana lissafin kuɗi na ba-zata.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Don mutane da albarkatun da ke cikin shirinku, za ku iya jera yadda za ku kare shiga asusu da damar shiga, da tilasta ƙa'idoji da MFA, RBAC, tags, Azure Policy ko resource locks, kuna ambaton aƙalla uku daga cikin waɗannan kayan aiki da abin da kowanne ke yi. Ta amfani da na'urar lissafin farashi ta Azure kyauta da Microsoft Learn, za ku iya ƙiyasta kuɗin wata-wata na shirinku da rubuta shirin karatun AZ-900, tare da ƙiyasin jimilla da fannoni biyu da kuka fi rauni a jarabawar.
Shaida (identity): Microsoft Entra ID ita ce hidimar shiga asusu da kundin sunaye (directory) ta Azure. Ku kunna multifactor authentication (MFA, tabbatarwa ta hanyoyi da yawa), wadda ke neman shaida ta biyu kamar code a cikin manhaja, don kalmar sirri da aka sace kaɗai ba za ta isa ba. Single sign-on (SSO) yana bar mutane su yi amfani da asusu ɗaya don manhajoji da yawa. Role-based access control (RBAC, damar shiga bisa matsayi) yana ba kowane mutum damar shiga da aikinsa ke buƙata kaɗai. Zero Trust yana nufin kada ku taɓa ɗauka cewa wata buƙata tana lafiya; koyaushe ku tabbatar.
Gudanarwa (governance): Azure Policy yana kafa ƙa'idoji, kamar "a ƙirƙiri albarkatu a waɗannan yankuna kaɗai". Resource locks (makullan albarkatu) suna hana a goge ko canja muhimman albarkatu bisa kuskure. Tags alamomi ne kamar department=youth ko project=website da ke taimaka muku rarrabawa da bin diddigin kuɗi. Microsoft Defender for Cloud yana duba tsarinku don neman matsalolin tsaro.
Kuɗi: abin da kuke biya ya dogara da hidimar, girmanta, yankin, tsawon lokacin da take aiki da yawan bayanan da ke fita daga Azure. Na'urar lissafin farashi ta Azure kyauta tana ƙiyasta kuɗin wata-wata kafin ku gina komai. Cost Management yana bar ku kafa kasafi (budget) da faɗakarwa (alerts). Ƙa'ida mai sauƙi: ku goge abin da ba ku amfani da shi.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku kunna MFA ga kowane asusu.
- Ku ba mutane damar shiga da aikinsu ke buƙata kaɗai (RBAC).
- Ku ƙara tags ga kowace albarka.
- Ku yi amfani da Azure Policy da resource locks don muhimman ƙa'idoji.
- Ku fara ƙiyasta kuɗi a na'urar lissafin farashi, sannan ku kafa faɗakarwar kasafi.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Microsoft Entra ID: hidimar Microsoft ta shiga asusu da kundin sunaye a cloud.
- Multifactor authentication (MFA): shiga asusu da kalmar sirri tare da shaida ta biyu.
- RBAC: role-based access control: damar shiga bisa aikin mutum.
- Zero Trust: hanyar tsaro: kada a taɓa ɗauka amana, koyaushe a tabbatar.
- Azure Policy: kayan aiki da ke tilasta ƙa'idoji kan abin da za a iya ƙirƙira.
- Resource lock (makullin albarka): yana hana a goge ko canja albarka bisa kuskure.
- Tag: alama a kan albarka da ake amfani da ita don rarraba ta da bin diddigin kuɗi.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft Learn: Jagorar karatu don jarabawar AZ-900
- Microsoft Azure: Na'urar lissafin farashi (pricing calculator)
Gwada yanzu: Ku rubuta ƙa'idojin tsaro da kuɗi uku don tsarin Azure na cibiyar al'umma, ɗaya don shiga asusu, ɗaya don damar shiga, ɗaya don kashe kuɗi. Misali: "Kowane asusun ɗan sa-kai yana amfani da MFA." Sannan ku rubuta tags biyu da za ku sa a kan kowace albarka.
Yanzu za ku iya bayyana yadda Azure ke kiyaye asusu, tilasta ƙa'idoji da riƙe kuɗi a ƙarƙashin iko.

options: A amince da kowace buƙata daga cikin ofis
Koyaushe a tabbatar; kada a taɓa ɗauka cewa buƙata tana lafiya
A kashe kalmomin sirri
A amince da mai bayar da cloud kaɗai
check.why: Zero Trust yana nufin ana duba kowace buƙata maimakon a ɗauka tana lafiya.

check.q: An sace kalmar sirrin wani ɗan sa-kai, amma ɓarawon bai iya shiga ba. Wace saitin ce ta fi yiwuwa ta hana shi?
options: Tag a kan albarkar
Matakin ma'ajiya mafi sanyi
Resource group
Multifactor authentication (MFA)
check.why: MFA tana neman shaida ta biyu, don haka kalmar sirri da aka sace kaɗai ba ta isa ba.

lessons.title: Darasi 6: Ƙiyasta kuɗi da shirya hanyarku ta AZ-900
lessons.text:
Darasi 6 cikin 6 · kusan minti 6
Manufa: Ƙiyasta kuɗin wata-wata a na'urar lissafin farashi da yin shirin karatu don AZ-900.
Wannan darasi yana shirya ku don: Ta amfani da na'urar lissafin farashi ta Azure kyauta da Microsoft Learn, za ku iya ƙiyasta kuɗin wata-wata na shirinku da rubuta shirin karatun AZ-900, tare da ƙiyasin jimilla da fannoni biyu da kuka fi rauni a jarabawar.
Na'urar lissafin farashi (pricing calculator) kyauta ce a shafin intanet na Microsoft. Kuna ƙara hidimomin da kuke shirin amfani da su, ku zaɓi yanki da zaɓuɓɓuka kamar girma da awanni, sai ta nuna ƙiyasin kuɗin wata-wata. Farashi yana canjawa kuma ya dogara da yanki, don haka koyaushe ku yi amfani da na'urar lissafi maimakon lambar da kuka karanta a wani wuri.
Idan kuna son yin atisaye a cikin Azure da kansa, Microsoft yana bayar da asusu kyauta mai wasu hidimomi kyauta na watanni 12 da fiye da hidimomi 65 kyauta kowane wata har zuwa wasu adadi, ga sababbin abokan ciniki. Ku karanta sharuɗɗan yanzu a shafin hidimomi kyauta na Microsoft kafin ku yi rajista, ku kafa faɗakarwar kasafi, kuma ku goge albarkatun atisaye idan kun gama. Ɗalibai suna iya cancanta da wani tayin Azure for Students daban da imel na makaranta.
Jarabawar takardar shaidar Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals ita ce AZ-900. Jagorar karatu ta Microsoft ta jera fannoni uku: ra'ayoyin cloud (25-30%), tsarin gine-gine da hidimomin Azure (35-40%), da gudanarwa da mulkin Azure (30-35%). Kuna buƙatar maki 700 ko fiye don ku ci. Shafin jarabawar ya jera minti 45 don gwajin, kuma farashin ya dogara da ƙasar da kuke yin ta, don haka ku duba shi a can. Microsoft Learn yana da horo kyauta da gwajin atisaye kyauta.
Mataki-mataki:
- Ku buɗe na'urar lissafin farashi ta Azure.
- Ku ƙara hidimomin da ke cikin shirinku, ku zaɓi yankinku da girma.
- Ku rubuta ƙiyasin jimillar kuɗin wata-wata.
- Ku buɗe shafin AZ-900 a Microsoft Learn ku yi gwajin atisaye kyauta.
- Ku jera fannoni biyu da kuka fi rauni a ciki da darussan Microsoft Learn kyauta na su.
Kalmomin da za ku sani:
- Na'urar lissafin farashi (pricing calculator): kayan aikin Microsoft kyauta don ƙiyasta kuɗin Azure kafin ku gina.
- AZ-900: lambar jarabawar Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals.
- Gwajin atisaye (practice assessment): tambayoyin atisaye kyauta a Microsoft Learn da ke nuna shirinku.
- Microsoft Learn: shafin intanet na Microsoft na horo da takardar shaida kyauta.
Majiyoyi na hukuma:
- Microsoft Azure: Na'urar lissafin farashi (pricing calculator)
- Microsoft Azure: Hidimomi kyauta
- Microsoft Learn: Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (takardar shaida)
- Microsoft Learn: Jagorar karatu don jarabawar AZ-900
Gwada yanzu: Aikin ƙarshe: ku rubuta shirin Azure mai shafi ɗaya don shafin intanet da ma'ajiyar fayiloli na wata ƙungiyar al'umma (hidimomi da nau'i, yanki, resource group, shiga asusu lafiya, tags da kasafi), ku ƙara ƙiyasin wata-wata daga na'urar lissafin farashi, sannan ku yi gwajin atisaye na AZ-900 kyauta ku jera fannoni biyu da kuka fi rauni a ciki.
Yanzu za ku iya tsarawa da ƙiyasta farashin ƙaramin tsarin Azure, da bin hanya a sarari zuwa takardar shaidar AZ-900.
Yadda ake duba aikinku na ƙarshe:
Abin da muke dubawa Har yanzu bai kai ba Ya cika Ya wuce Nau'in hidima da hidimomi Shirin bai ambaci hidimomin Azure ba, ko kuma ba su dace da shafin intanet da ma'ajiyar fayiloli ba. Ya ambaci nau'in hidima (IaaS, PaaS ko SaaS) da hidimomin da suka dace, kamar App Service da storage account. Ya faɗi dalilin da yasa kowace hidima ta fi wani zaɓi dacewa. Yanki da tsari Ba a ambaci yanki ko resource group ba. Ya ambaci yanki tare da dalili, kuma ya sa albarkatun a resource group ɗaya. Ya kuma ambaci subscription da ke biya, da ko ana buƙatar availability zones. Shiga asusu lafiya da ƙa'idoji Bai faɗi yadda mutane ke shiga asusu ko wanda zai iya yin me ba. Yana amfani da MFA kuma yana ba kowane mutum damar shiga da yake buƙata kaɗai (RBAC). Ya kuma ƙara tags, policy ko resource lock kuma ya faɗi abin da kowanne ke karewa. Ƙiyasin kuɗi Babu ƙiyasi, ko lambar da ba a ɗauko daga na'urar lissafin farashi ba. Ya ba da ƙiyasin jimillar kuɗin wata-wata daga na'urar lissafin farashi da faɗakarwar kasafi. Ya ambaci canji ɗaya da zai rage kuɗin, kamar matakin ma'ajiya mafi sanyi. Shirin karatu Ba a yi gwajin atisaye ba. Ya yi gwajin atisaye kyauta kuma ya jera fannoni biyu da ya fi rauni a ciki. Ya haɗa kowane fanni mai rauni da darasin Microsoft Learn kyauta da ranar da zai karanta shi. Don cin nasara: "Ya cika" ko "Ya wuce" a kowane layi. Idan wani layi "Bai kai ba tukuna", ku gyara wannan sashe ku sake gwadawa.
